title: Move the icons & fix the ads!
content:

Sometimes ads will just be there, no X button which causes you to close the app and open it again. The graphics of this game is great. I love all the different themes, some more difficult which is great. However, some items are extremely hidden where you can’t even see it which sucks. There isn’t a timer, so you can look as long as you need, zoom in and out. You can tap all you want and it won’t pause you or time you out. 
I know these themes are AI generated, but it sucks that not all items are hidden already. You basically go back and forth on the picture because an item you’re looking for ‘magically appears’ where you already looked. While playing this game, some times the ad on the bottom would pop up, which I don’t like, but you can swipe it down. Another thing, the home icon, setting icon, magnifying glass & compass icon is in the way. There are times when an item I’m looking for is behind the icons my finger taps on the icon instead of the item and I wasted it. Or if I didn’t have any left, an ad starts took. PLEASE MOVE IT!

author: 7A.M.M.4
title: Mostly Good and relaxing
content:
First: just a reminder to blink a lot more than you feel you should when you're playing games like this because you don't blink as much as as usual, and also stare off into the distance that once in a while to give your eyes a rest. 

I do like this one because it actually challenges you some, but there's no timer so you can just do it in a relaxed manner. And if you click a spot accidentally it doesn't penalize you like other ones. I've stuck with this one through the most levels so far. Most of the pictures and items are nice.

I don't like that when it calls levels "hard" they are actually only hard on the eyes. The objects are really usually just so tiny that it is hard to see them in my iPhone, (and on top of that it can also be that there's so little of the object sticking out from behind something that you can hardly see it, or it's a different color because it's in a shadow.  Also, there are other items just like it that are a different color, that aren't the item you're looking for.) But like I said, it doesn't penalize you for clicking in the wrong spot and I just pinch out my screen when I get to the ones that are too small in order to save my eyes. (Then, sometimes it gets more annoying and less relaxing.)  My biggest complaint is that it's dumb that you have to watch a commercial to skip a level when you don't like the artwork. I am very opposed to anything Spiritistic/Satanic like magic spells, witches, violence, etc. So I skip those if theme is like that. Why should I have to sit through a commercial and the owner get paid for things that are against my values? And it seems like an app creator could figure out what some people don't like and make sure that there is a level of that every once in a while on a so that they get paid more from commercials. 

Otherwise I think this is a good hidden pics. And it has some lovely, fun, happy and/or relaxing pictures

author: elenacorinne
title: More games should be like this one.
content:
Every level of the game is a full-screen panoramic illustration with a few gifs scattered throughout, such as floating butterflies, or sparks from a campfire. At the bottom of the screen is list of objects or figures, and the quantities of each, that must be found within the illustration. The illustrations are fanciful, extremely detailed, and highly varied. There are women, men, children, and elderly people in every picture. Men are depicted caring for children. Elderly people are depicted as active, employed, and entertaining. Women and men have a range of body types. Everyone is shown in all kinds of moods. There are dogs and cats in every picture, with a ratio slightly in favor of cats. In every picture, a horrible mess is being made, someone is busy working, someone is sleeping, several are eating, someone is overreacting, and there’s usually a dragon somewhere, regardless of setting. There are always “leftover” hidden objects from previous levels to trick you, and objects similar to the required ones. There are three levels of cheating allowed: watch a mercifully brief ad, and a compass appears on screen to point to the hidden object.  Watch a slightly longer ad, and they will just show you the object. Watch a full one-minute ad, and you can skip a level altogether. Or don’t cheat, and earn a generous amount of coins per level. Here’s a tip: expand the image to find objects. The detail expands with the screen. 

Five out of five.

They are all quite fun and have so much going on in them that I feel I sometimes miss out on the small details while searching for the items.

author: Gaming Momma02
title: Love this game
content: I downloaded this game to keep me busy and it really has. I got my niece addicted to it recently. It reminds me of the hidden objects page that are in the highlights magazines. I have my personal own on my ipad and i can take it everywhere with me.

author: Rocketboynj
title: They cheat
content: I play a level one day and I find almost all the objects. I go back next day and there are new objects. I have screenshots if you want to see them.

author: Saginaw Twp
title: Game Question
content: I love this game because of the detailed scenes. You really have to look for the items. One pet peeve is that all of these scenes are mirror image. Meaning all of the words are seen backwards. Why? You should take a minute to fix this problem.

author: AngrySurveyor
title: Great Game but….
content: This is a great game but after probably round 150 most of the levels are just recycled. So you mainly just play levels you’ve already played. The image is the same but they do change the hidden objects a bit but still it’s not fun playing the same image/level over and over again.

author: dancedani
title: AI Garbage
content: I wanted to love this, but it became quickly apparent that the scenes are AI garbage. I refuse to support lazy “developers.”

I shrink it back down but every second there it goes again. I would cancel adds but not now. I’ll just delete it . Do not leave a message here because I’ll never find it. author: Trmeyer
title: Was good. But now the Ads are nonstop
content: I’ve been playing this game for a week or so. The ads were not bad. Now today it has Google ads at the bottom of the game screen and it opens up about every 15 seconds.  I don’t know if it’s a glitch or something but if this continues to happen I will not be playing this game anymore. And yes, I do understand I can pay to not have ads, but I don’t like being forced to.

author: Amyk197120
title: Ads are intrusive and annoying
content: I’ve been playing for several months. I don’t mind the ads before and after a level is completed. There are now ads that start at the bottom of the page as a banner and then rise up/open up and cover half of the game every time I touch anything. These are not standard “pop-ups,” this is something entirely different and there’s no way I’m going to waste time playing a game that takes me more time to close the ads than actually playing the game. I love this game, but I don’t love anything enough to waste my time. Hopefully this will be fixed and stop the banner ads at the bottom from overtaking my entire screen. I’ll wait a couple of days before I delete this app if it’s still unresolved.

title: Reset progress
content: After I re-downloaded the game, my progress was gone and I had to start from the first level again. I want to resume the progress.

author: Patrol Pilot
title: Paid —- Don’t
content: Paid for ad free and still have to sit through them. Don’t bother with this app!!!

author: DeeAnn77
title: Search It - Hidden Objects is a Hidden GEM
content:
GET THIS GAME! Hours of fun with little to no cost! I love purchasing from companies/games that don’t force it on me. I especially enjoy the no timer aspect of the game. 

Artwork is good, although unless it’s really blatant, I can’t discern the difference between AI and honest art. I can when it’s side-by-side.

Anyway, this game is chock full of fun! They have added a fun little “find 3 mushrooms”.

To the creators: Thank you for creating a fun game that doesn’t break the bank and for heaven’s sake, PLEASE, please, please “don’t fix what ain’t broken”! 🥰

author: Buddhagel
title: Addicting Hidden Object game but…
content: I downloaded this hidden object game, paid $8.99 for no ads and played through all available levels within a week. The levels are fun and addicting but I certainly expected more levels especially if I’m going to pay $8.99 for no adds. It’s a disappointment.
